source: Changing the system volume, application volume, or headphone position after this point invalidates the result.
translation: Changing the system volume, application volume, or headphone position after this point invalidates the result.

source: Choose the microphone and headphone devices that should be used for the testing procedure.
translation: Choose the microphone and headphone devices that should be used for the testing procedure.

source: Do not change the system volume, application volume, headphone position, or microphone position.
translation: Do not change the system volume, application volume, headphone position, or microphone position.

source: Four hours of steady work faced us.
translation: Four hours of steady work faced us.

source: How does the loudness compare with your preferred loudness?
translation: How does the loudness compare with your preferred loudness?

source: I am wearing headphones and am not using computer speakers.
translation: I am wearing headphones and am not using computer speakers.

source: I will use only the sliders in this application and will not change the system or application volume.
translation: I will use only the sliders in this application and will not change the system or application volume.

source: Is the loudness of the speech much quieter than preferred, quieter than preferred, preferred, louder than preferred, or much louder than preferred?
translation: Is the loudness of the speech much quieter than preferred, quieter than preferred, preferred, louder than preferred, or much louder than preferred?

source: Keep the headphones in the same position throughout the procedure. You will receive separate instructions for the microphone.
translation: Keep the headphones in the same position throughout the procedure. You will receive separate instructions for the microphone.

source: Listen to the speech and adjust the slider until the loudness is comfortable. Releasing the slider restarts the sample at the selected level.
translation: Listen to the speech and adjust the slider until the loudness is comfortable. Releasing the slider restarts the sample at the selected level.

source: Listen to your recording and adjust the slider until your recorded voice has a comfortable loudness. Releasing the slider restarts the recording.
translation: Listen to your recording and adjust the slider until your recorded voice has a comfortable loudness. Releasing the slider restarts the recording.

source: Position the microphone approximately 2 cm from your mouth, if the equipment permits it. Do not move it for the remainder of the procedure.
translation: Position the microphone approximately 2 cm from your mouth, if the equipment permits it. Do not move it for the remainder of the procedure.

source: Press Record, read both sentences aloud at your normal speaking level, and then press Stop.
translation: Press Record, read both sentences aloud at your normal speaking level, and then press Stop.

source: Recording complete. You may replay your recording, record again, or continue.
translation: Recording complete. You may replay your recording, record again, or continue.

source: Thank you. Your calibration and loudness ratings have been saved. You are now finished.
translation: Thank you. Your calibration and loudness ratings have been saved. You are now finished.

source: The hogs were fed with chopped corn and garbage.
translation: The hogs were fed with chopped corn and garbage.

source: The juice of lemons makes fine punch.
translation: The juice of lemons makes fine punch.

source: The procedure was interrupted. Please contact the supervisor.
translation: The procedure was interrupted. Please contact the supervisor.

translation: These days a chicken leg is a rare dish.

translation: This procedure will help determine comfortable speech playback levels and then ask you to rate two speech samples.

source: You will hear two speech samples without a volume slider. After each sample, rate how its loudness compares with the loudness you would prefer.
translation: You will hear two speech samples without a volume slider. After each sample, rate how its loudness compares with the loudness you would prefer.
